bankerSummary: Young family, not yet an FNB customer, steady income. Income: $2,400/mo job = about $2,400/mo effective. Fixed costs $1,500, debt payments $150 (69% of income), surplus $750/mo, savings $1,200, credit range: fair. Spending plan: $375/mo savings, $375/mo guilt-free. Goals: first home ($15,000 in 60 months, P1, $150/mo of $250/mo needed); emergency fund ($5,000 est. in 12 months, P2, $225/mo of $413/mo needed). Plan: now Mortgage calculators, Freestyle Checking, FirstRate Savings; next Flex CD; later FNB Home Ownership Program.
